mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_BOARD_S ( GRUP_CFY_CD, BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL, BLBR_TITL_NM, FIRST_INPPR_ID, FIRST_INPPR_NM, FIRST_INPT_DT, UPDR_ID, UPDR_NM, MDF_DT, BLBR_CTT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{GRUP_CFY_CD}, #{BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{BLBR_TITL_NM}, #{FIRST_INPPR_ID}, #{FIRST_INPPR_NM}, SYSDATE, #{UPDR_ID}, #{UPDR_NM}, SYSDATE, #{BLBR_CTT}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT GRUP_CFY_CD, BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL, BLBR_TITL_NM, FIRST_INPPR_ID, FIRST_INPPR_NM, FIRST_INPT_DT, UPDR_ID, UPDR_NM, MDF_DT, BLBR_CTT, TO_CHAR(MDF_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_MDF_DT, (SELECT ATFL_ORSRC_NM || '.' || ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM ='GE_MP_BOARD_S' AND UNQ_NO = A.BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL AND ATFL_ID = '1') ONAME1, (SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM || '/' || ATFL_PHCL_NM || '.' || ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM ='GE_MP_BOARD_S' AND UNQ_NO = A.BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL AND ATFL_ID = '1') FNAME1 FROM GE_MP_BOARD_S A WHERE BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_BOARD_S SET BLBR_TITL_NM = #{BLBR_TITL_NM}, BLBR_CTT = #{BLBR_CTT}, UPDR_ID = #{UPDR_ID}, UPDR_NM = #{UPDR_NM}, MDF_DT = SYSDATE WHERE BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL}
UPDATE GE_MP_BOARD_S SET DLT_YN = 'Y', UPDR_ID = #{UPDR_ID}, UPDR_NM = #{UPDR_NM}, MDF_DT = SYSDATE WHERE BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{BLBR_UNQ_KY_VAL}
